briefs.source_chain: Token prices (Silicon Data index) are falling faster than volume is rising (JPM: OpenRouter volume +47% m/m, spend only +7%), so cheaper tokens are not paying for the capex bet; unless Astra delivers a capability jump, compute oversupply is plausible, and credit (hyperscaler bonds trading below issue, ~$737bn 2026 capex at 38% of revenue) is already pricing that risk ahead of equities; three counterarguments exist but don't rescue multiples; separately GS's Schneider stays Buy Broadcom
